recipe.failure: Make only the task-owned local launch directory0555 and prove actual create_new PermissionDenied before spawn. Actual selected sleep then fails PreparedLaunch.record; restore directory mode immediately after capture. Retain original PermissionDenied trace, outer NotFound from local completion, actual kill/reap and separate ambient completion result; no local receipt is fabricated.
recipe.completion: Retain actual kill/reap and independently attempted local/ambient completions. Local recording failed, so require zero local launches/exits and a failed local completion; never fabricate a local receipt pair. Preserve original PermissionDenied trace separately from returned NotFound. A successful ambient completion API may be a no-op only in an ordinary unmeasured narrow invocation; full qualification must retain the actual active ambient receipt.
